criteria.label: P/E or PEG
criteria.help: Passes if trailing P/E is 0-30, or PEG is 0-2 for faster growers.

criteria.label: FCF yield
criteria.help: Trailing free cash flow / market cap.

criteria.label: Price / sales
criteria.help: Useful for low-margin or cyclical names.

criteria.label: EPS growth, 3Y CAGR
criteria.help: Diluted EPS; needs positive EPS at both ends.

criteria.label: Revenue growth, latest quarter YoY
criteria.help: Is growth still there right now?

criteria.label: ROIC, latest year
criteria.help: NOPAT / (debt + equity - cash). Not inflated by leverage like ROE.

criteria.label: ROIC, multi-year average
criteria.help: Average of up to 4 fiscal years.

criteria.label: Debt / equity
criteria.help: Negative equity counts as a fail.

criteria.label: Altman Z-score
criteria.help: Above 3 is the classic safe zone.

criteria.label: 12-1 month momentum
criteria.help: Return from 12 months ago to 1 month ago. The momentum signal that persists.
